spec.prompt:
Asset sheet for FIRST-PERSON TRAVEL scenes of a life-simulation game set in Huambo, Angola (Angolan central highlands). NOT isometric: these are seen from the passenger's eyes, flat front views, each item isolated on a transparent background with clear empty space around it, no text other than what is asked.
ROW 1 - VEHICLE INTERIOR FRAMES, each a wide image whose CENTRE IS EMPTY/TRANSPARENT (the windshield/window opening) so the road can be seen through it: (1) inside a blue-and-white Toyota HiAce candongueiro minibus seen from the back seats: windshield frame, rear-view mirror with a rosary, dashboard with stickers, driver from behind with a cap, the cobrador's seat; (2) inside a city taxi (yellow-and-blue details), windshield frame, dashboard with a phone holder, driver's head from behind; (3) kupapata motorbike seen from the passenger seat: the rider's back and helmet, handlebar, mirrors; (4) inside a long-distance bus: windshield, rows of seat backs, TV screen; (5) inside a private car: steering wheel and dashboard with a small screen, windshield frame.
ROW 2 - ROADSIDE OBJECTS seen from the road at eye level, flat front view, each isolated: 6 different Huambo buildings facades (colonial pastel house, cantina with Coca-Cola adverts, apartment block, church, small market stall row, petrol station), 4 trees (jacaranda in bloom, eucalyptus, palm tree, mango tree), 2 large empty roadside billboards on poles (blank white board for adverts), 2 street lamps, 2 road signs in Portuguese ('Huambo', 'Devagar'), 1 bus stop shelter.
ROWS 3-6 - more roadside items, each isolated, flat front view: 6 people walking (zungueira with basin on head, man with a bicycle, students in uniform, woman with a baby on her back, kupapata rider, man selling phone credit), 6 more trees and bushes, 4 parked cars, 2 candongueiros seen from behind, 3 kupapatas, 4 stalls of fruit and vegetables, 6 small houses (adobe with zinc roofs), 4 electricity poles, 4 small walls with gates, 3 kiosks (Unitel, Movicel, Africell), 4 sacks of charcoal, 3 piles of bricks, 2 goats, 3 chickens, 2 flags of Angola, 2 water tanks, 4 street vendors' umbrellas, 2 donkeys with carts, 3 road cones, 2 tyres, 4 flower pots, 3 benches.
Every item fully separated by transparent space so each one can be cut out automatically; more than 100 items in total.

request.prompt:
High-definition 2D game art for a modern, polished life-simulation game (cozy, detailed, professional mobile game quality). Clean digital illustration with crisp edges, soft painterly shading, gentle ambient occlusion, warm natural daylight coming from the top-left. Consistent isometric camera: 2:1 dimetric projection (about 30 degrees elevation, rotated 45 degrees), as in classic isometric life-sim games.
Huge game ASSET SHEET for ONE whole Huambo neighbourhood: many separate, fully isolated isometric game assets laid out in a loose grid on a fully transparent background, each asset completely visible and separated from the others by clear empty space (no overlapping, no ground between them, no streets, no shadows connecting them). All assets share the same isometric camera, light direction and scale (a 2-storey house is about 1.5 times the height of a person-sized street lamp ratio as in reality). Bigger buildings first in the upper rows, smaller props below.

Setting: present-day Huambo, Angola (central highlands, ~1700 m altitude). Use the real local context: Portuguese colonial-era buildings in pastel colors (pink, ochre, pale yellow, light blue) with terracotta tile roofs and arched porticos; 1960s-70s modernist concrete apartment blocks with balconies, water tanks and satellite dishes on the roofs; newer cement-block houses with corrugated zinc roofs, painted walls and simple metal gates; small shops (cantinas) with hand-painted signs and Coca-Cola/Cuca adverts; red-earth (laterite) ground, jacaranda, eucalyptus and palm trees, bougainvillea; blue-and-white candongueiro minibuses, kupapata motorbike taxis, zungueiras with basins on their heads; all signage written in Portuguese. Never a generic or Western city.
Avoid: pixel art, low resolution, blur, photo-realism, 3D render look, watermarks, extra limbs, cropped parts, background scenery.
